labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Usage question: Rich strips \r from printed text; Live/progress are the documented way to update a line in place.

body:
Rich strips carriage returns from printed text, so `\r` does not move the cursor back the way the built-in `print()` does (see [control.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/control.py)). To update a line in place, use [Live](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst) or the progress display in [progress.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) instead of writing `\r` yourself. For further questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
